report_comment.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis. CBFA2T3 encodes a transcriptional corepressor involved in hematopoietic differentiation. The t(16;21)(q24;q22) fusion joins RUNX1 and CBFA2T3. In pediatric AML, its expression profile clustered near RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML. In the pediatric I-BFM cohort, outcomes resembled other core-binding factor leukemias and were substantially better than those of FUS::ERG AML.
